title: Lateral and Total Surface Area with Nets
seo_title: Grade 7 Lateral and Total Surface Area Worksheets with Nets (TEKS 7.9D, STAAR)
standard_text: 7.9D solve problems involving the lateral and total surface area of a rectangular prism, rectangular pyramid, triangular prism, and triangular pyramid by determining the area of the shape's net
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 surface area worksheets for Texas TEKS 7.9D: nets, rectangular prisms, lateral and total surface area, pyramids and triangular prisms, and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Lateral = sides only. Total = lateral + bases.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A net is a flat pattern that folds into a solid. The surface area is the total area of the net.
  • Lateral surface area is the area of the sides only (no bases). For a prism: perimeter of the base × height.
  • Total surface area = lateral area + the areas of the bases.
  • A rectangular pyramid has 1 rectangle base and 4 triangle faces; a triangular prism has 2 triangle bases and 3 rectangles.

Examples

Example

Box 5 cm × 3 cm × 4 cm

Lateral: 2(5 + 3) × 4 = 64

Bases: 2 × 15 = 30

Answer: 94 cm²

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting each pair of faces onceA box has 6 faces: 3 pairs.
Including the bases in lateral areaLateral area is the sides only.
Mixing up surface area and volumeSurface area is in square units; volume is in cubic units.

faq.a: Solve problems involving the lateral and total surface area of a rectangular prism, rectangular pyramid, triangular prism and triangular pyramid by determining the area of the shape's net.

faq.q: What is the difference between lateral and total surface area?
faq.a: Total surface area includes the bases; lateral does not.

faq.q: When do I use lateral area?
faq.a: For things with no top or bottom, like the label on a box or the walls of a room.

faq.q: How do I find the area of a pyramid's net?
faq.a: Add the base and the triangle faces: ½ × base × slant height for each triangle.

items.q: How many vertices does a cube have?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

items.q: This net is folded into a cube. Which face is opposite face A?
items.e: Faces A and B are in a straight line with one square between them, so they fold onto opposite sides of the cube.

items.q: How many edges does a rectangular prism have?
items.e: A rectangular prism has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

items.q: How many vertices does a square pyramid have?
items.e: A square pyramid has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

items.q: How many edges does a square pyramid have?
items.e: A square pyramid has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

items.q: How many faces does a triangular prism have?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

items.q: This net is folded into a cube. Which face is opposite face C?
items.e: Fold the net: face D lands across from face C. A face that touches C in the net (B, F) is next to it on the cube, never opposite.

items.q: How many triangles are in a net of a square pyramid?
items.e: A square pyramid has 1 square base and 4 triangle faces, so its net has 4 triangles.

items.q: How many edges does a triangular prism have?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

items.q: This is a net of a rectangular prism. Which face is the same size and shape as face E?
items.e: Face E and face F are both 5 by 4 rectangles, so they are opposite faces of the box. A box has 3 pairs of matching faces.

items.q: This is a net of a rectangular prism. Which face is the same size and shape as face A?
items.e: Face A and face C are both 4 by 3 rectangles, so they are opposite faces of the box. A box has 3 pairs of matching faces.

items.q: This is a net of a rectangular prism. Which face is the same size and shape as face D?
items.e: Face D and face A are both 5 by 3 rectangles, so they are opposite faces of the box. A box has 3 pairs of matching faces.

items.q: This net is folded into a cube. Which face is opposite face F?
items.e: Fold the net: face A lands across from face F. A face that touches F in the net (C, E) is next to it on the cube, never opposite.

items.q: This is a net of a rectangular prism. Which face is the same size and shape as face B?
items.e: Face B and face C are both 3 by 4 rectangles, so they are opposite faces of the box. A box has 3 pairs of matching faces.

items.q: This net is folded into a cube. Which face is opposite face B?
items.e: Fold the net: face A lands across from face B. A face that touches B in the net (E, F) is next to it on the cube, never opposite.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 3 cm by 5 cm by 8 cm. How many of its faces are 3 cm by 5 cm rectangles?
items.e: Faces come in matching pairs: 2 faces are 3 by 5, 2 are 3 by 8 and 2 are 5 by 8.

items.q: How many vertices does a triangular prism have?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

items.q: How many rectangles are in a net of a triangular prism?
items.e: A triangular prism has 2 triangle bases and 3 rectangle faces, one for each side of the triangle.

items.q: How many faces does a square pyramid have?
items.e: A square pyramid has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

items.q: This net is folded into a cube. Which face is opposite face B?
items.e: Faces B and A are in a straight line with one square between them, so they fold onto opposite sides of the cube.

items.q: Find the surface area of a rectangular prism 5 cm by 3 cm by 4 cm.
items.e: Three pairs of faces: 2(5 × 3) + 2(5 × 4) + 2(3 × 4) = 30 + 40 + 24 = 94 square centimeters. Not 47: count all 6 faces.

items.q: Find the surface area of a rectangular prism 6 cm by 2 cm by 3 cm.
items.e: Three pairs of faces: 2(6 × 2) + 2(6 × 3) + 2(2 × 3) = 24 + 36 + 12 = 72 square centimeters. Not 36: count all 6 faces.

items.q: Find the surface area of a rectangular prism 8 cm by 5 cm by 2 cm.
items.e: Three pairs of faces: 2(8 × 5) + 2(8 × 2) + 2(5 × 2) = 80 + 32 + 20 = 132 square centimeters. Not 66: count all 6 faces.

items.q: Find the surface area of a rectangular prism 4 cm by 4 cm by 4 cm.
items.e: Three pairs of faces: 2(4 × 4) + 2(4 × 4) + 2(4 × 4) = 32 + 32 + 32 = 96 square centimeters. Not 48: count all 6 faces.

items.q: Find the surface area of a rectangular prism 10 cm by 6 cm by 3 cm.
items.e: Three pairs of faces: 2(10 × 6) + 2(10 × 3) + 2(6 × 3) = 120 + 60 + 36 = 216 square centimeters. Not 108: count all 6 faces.

items.q: Find the surface area of a rectangular prism 7 cm by 3 cm by 5 cm.
items.e: Three pairs of faces: 2(7 × 3) + 2(7 × 5) + 2(3 × 5) = 42 + 70 + 30 = 142 square centimeters. Not 71: count all 6 faces.

items.q: Find the surface area of a rectangular prism 9 cm by 2 cm by 4 cm.
items.e: Three pairs of faces: 2(9 × 2) + 2(9 × 4) + 2(2 × 4) = 36 + 72 + 16 = 124 square centimeters. Not 62: count all 6 faces.

items.q: What is the surface area of a cube with edges 3 in.?
items.e: 6 faces, each 3 × 3 = 9 in². 6 × 9 = 54 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of a cube with edges 5 in.?
items.e: 6 faces, each 5 × 5 = 25 in². 6 × 25 = 150 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of a cube with edges 7 in.?
items.e: 6 faces, each 7 × 7 = 49 in². 6 × 49 = 294 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of a cube with edges 10 in.?
items.e: 6 faces, each 10 × 10 = 100 in². 6 × 100 = 600 in².

items.q: A triangular prism has right-triangle bases with legs 6 cm and 8 cm and hypotenuse 10 cm. The prism is 5 cm long. What is its surface area?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × ½ × 6 × 8 = 48. Three rectangles: (6 + 8 + 10) × 5 = 120. Total 168 square centimeters.

items.q: A triangular prism has right-triangle bases with legs 3 cm and 4 cm and hypotenuse 5 cm. The prism is 10 cm long. What is its surface area?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × ½ × 3 × 4 = 12. Three rectangles: (3 + 4 + 5) × 10 = 120. Total 132 square centimeters.

items.q: A triangular prism has right-triangle bases with legs 5 cm and 12 cm and hypotenuse 13 cm. The prism is 4 cm long. What is its surface area?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × ½ × 5 × 12 = 60. Three rectangles: (5 + 12 + 13) × 4 = 120. Total 180 square centimeters.

items.q: A triangular prism has right-triangle bases with legs 9 cm and 12 cm and hypotenuse 15 cm. The prism is 6 cm long. What is its surface area?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × ½ × 9 × 12 = 108. Three rectangles: (9 + 12 + 15) × 6 = 216. Total 324 square centimeters.

items.q: Which measures the space inside a box?
items.e: Volume (cubic units) measures the space inside. Surface area (square units) measures the outside covering.

items.q: Wrapping paper covers a gift box. Which do you need to find?
items.e: Paper covers the outside faces, so you need the surface area.

items.q: Which unit fits a surface area?
items.e: Surface area is an area, so it uses square units.

items.q: A net of a rectangular prism has how many rectangles?
items.e: A rectangular prism has 6 faces, so its net has 6 rectangles.

items.q: Doubling every edge of a cube makes its volume how many times as large?
items.e: Volume = s³. (2s)³ = 8s³. (Surface area becomes 4 times as large.)

items.q: A rectangular prism is 15 cm long, 3 cm wide and 3 cm tall. What is its lateral surface area (the four side faces)?
items.e: Lateral area = perimeter of the base × height = 2(15 + 3) × 3 = 108 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 8 cm long, 9 cm wide and 9 cm tall. What is its lateral surface area (the four side faces)?
items.e: Lateral area = perimeter of the base × height = 2(8 + 9) × 9 = 306 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 14 cm long, 6 cm wide and 8 cm tall. What is its lateral surface area (the four side faces)?
items.e: Lateral area = perimeter of the base × height = 2(14 + 6) × 8 = 320 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 9 cm long, 5 cm wide and 4 cm tall. Its lateral area is 112 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 112 + 2 × 9 × 5 = 202 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 14 cm long, 10 cm wide and 9 cm tall. What is its lateral surface area (the four side faces)?
items.e: Lateral area = perimeter of the base × height = 2(14 + 10) × 9 = 432 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 11 cm long, 6 cm wide and 5 cm tall. What is its lateral surface area (the four side faces)?
items.e: Lateral area = perimeter of the base × height = 2(11 + 6) × 5 = 170 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 7 cm long, 4 cm wide and 4 cm tall. Its lateral area is 88 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 88 + 2 × 7 × 4 = 144 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 6 cm long, 4 cm wide and 2 cm tall. Its lateral area is 40 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 40 + 2 × 6 × 4 = 88 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 13 cm long, 5 cm wide and 4 cm tall. Its lateral area is 144 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 144 + 2 × 13 × 5 = 274 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 5 cm long, 10 cm wide and 9 cm tall. Its lateral area is 270 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 270 + 2 × 5 × 10 = 370 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 5 cm long, 2 cm wide and 5 cm tall. Its lateral area is 70 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 70 + 2 × 5 × 2 = 90 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 10 cm long, 9 cm wide and 5 cm tall. Its lateral area is 190 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 190 + 2 × 10 × 9 = 370 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 12 cm long, 2 cm wide and 9 cm tall. Its lateral area is 252 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 252 + 2 × 12 × 2 = 300 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 12 cm long, 9 cm wide and 10 cm tall. Its lateral area is 420 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 420 + 2 × 12 × 9 = 636 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 8 cm long, 10 cm wide and 5 cm tall. What is its lateral surface area (the four side faces)?
items.e: Lateral area = perimeter of the base × height = 2(8 + 10) × 5 = 180 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 15 cm long, 8 cm wide and 8 cm tall. Its lateral area is 368 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 368 + 2 × 15 × 8 = 608 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 12 cm long, 5 cm wide and 10 cm tall. Its lateral area is 340 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 340 + 2 × 12 × 5 = 460 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 10 cm long, 8 cm wide and 7 cm tall. Its lateral area is 252 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 252 + 2 × 10 × 8 = 412 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 9 cm long, 9 cm wide and 12 cm tall. Its lateral area is 432 square centimeters. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Total = lateral + 2 bases = 432 + 2 × 9 × 9 = 594 square centimeters.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 4 cm long, 2 cm wide and 3 cm tall. What is its lateral surface area (the four side faces)?
items.e: Lateral area = perimeter of the base × height = 2(4 + 2) × 3 = 36 square centimeters.

items.q: A square pyramid has a base 10 in on each side. The pyramid is 12 in tall, and the slant height (the height of each triangle face) is 13 in. What is its surface area?
items.e: Base: 10 × 10 = 100. One triangle: 12 × 10 × 13 = 65. Four triangles: 4 × 65 = 260. Total: 100 + 260 = 360 in². Use the slant height 13, not the height of the pyramid, for the triangle faces.

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 6 × 6 = 36. One triangle: 12 × 6 × 9 = 27. Four triangles: 4 × 27 = 108. Total: 36 + 108 = 144 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 6 × 8 = 48. Three rectangles: (6 + 8 + 10) × 12 = 24 × 12 = 288. Total: 48 + 288 = 336 ft².

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 5 × 5 = 25. One triangle: 12 × 5 × 8 = 20. Four triangles: 4 × 20 = 80. Total: 25 + 80 = 105 ft².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 3 × 4 = 12. Three rectangles: (3 + 4 + 5) × 7 = 12 × 7 = 84. Total: 12 + 84 = 96 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 6 × 6 = 36. One triangle: 12 × 6 × 5 = 15. Four triangles: 4 × 15 = 60. Total: 36 + 60 = 96 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 4 × 4 = 16. One triangle: 12 × 4 × 6 = 12. Four triangles: 4 × 12 = 48. Total: 16 + 48 = 64 square centimeters. Remember the 12 in the triangle area.

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 8 × 8 = 64. One triangle: 12 × 8 × 7 = 28. Four triangles: 4 × 28 = 112. Total: 64 + 112 = 176 square meters.

items.q: Which expression gives the surface area of this square pyramid?
items.e: The base is 7 × 7. Each of the 4 triangles is 12 × 7 × 9. Total: 49 + 126 = 175 square meters.

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 7 × 7 = 49. One triangle: 12 × 7 × 10 = 35. Four triangles: 4 × 35 = 140. Total: 49 + 140 = 189 ft².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 16 × 6 = 96. Three rectangles: (10 + 16 + 10) × 20 = 36 × 20 = 720. Total: 96 + 720 = 816 in². Use the dashed height (6 in), not the slanted side, for the triangles.

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 10 × 12 = 120. Three rectangles: (13 + 10 + 13) × 15 = 36 × 15 = 540. Total: 120 + 540 = 660 square centimeters. Use the dashed height (12 cm), not the slanted side, for the triangles.

items.q: A triangular prism has right-triangle bases with sides 3 ft, 4 ft and 5 ft. The prism is 6 ft long. Which expression gives its surface area?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 3 × 4 = 12. Three rectangles: (3 + 4 + 5) × 6 = 72. Total: 12 + 72 = 84 ft².

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 10 × 10 = 100. One triangle: 12 × 10 × 12 = 60. Four triangles: 4 × 60 = 240. Total: 100 + 240 = 340 square centimeters. Remember the 12 in the triangle area.

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 9 × 12 = 108. Three rectangles: (9 + 12 + 15) × 20 = 36 × 20 = 720. Total: 108 + 720 = 828 square centimeters.

items.q: A square pyramid has a base 6 cm on each side. The pyramid is 4 cm tall, and the slant height (the height of each triangle face) is 5 cm. What is its surface area?
items.e: Base: 6 × 6 = 36. One triangle: 12 × 6 × 5 = 15. Four triangles: 4 × 15 = 60. Total: 36 + 60 = 96 square centimeters. Use the slant height 5, not the height of the pyramid, for the triangle faces.

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 3 × 4 = 12. Three rectangles: (3 + 4 + 5) × 9 = 12 × 9 = 108. Total: 12 + 108 = 120 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 6 × 4 = 24. Three rectangles: (5 + 6 + 5) × 9 = 16 × 9 = 144. Total: 24 + 144 = 168 ft². Use the dashed height (4 ft), not the slanted side, for the triangles.

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 5 × 12 = 60. Three rectangles: (5 + 12 + 13) × 10 = 30 × 10 = 300. Total: 60 + 300 = 360 square meters.

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 8 × 3 = 24. Three rectangles: (5 + 8 + 5) × 10 = 18 × 10 = 180. Total: 24 + 180 = 204 square meters. Use the dashed height (3 m), not the slanted side, for the triangles.

items.q: Carlos covers a cube-shaped gift box with paper. Each edge is 10 cm. How much paper does he need?
items.e: One face: 10 × 10 = 100 square centimeters. Six faces: 6 × 100 = 600 square centimeters. 1,000 is the volume in cm³.

items.q: Box A is a cube with 6 in edges. Box B is 9 in by 4 in by 6 in. Both hold 216 in³. Which box needs more paper to cover it?
items.e: A: 6 × 36 = 216 in². B: 2 × 36 + 2 × 54 + 2 × 24 = 228 in². B needs 228 − 216 = 12 in² more. The same volume does not mean the same surface area.

items.q: A roof is shaped like a square pyramid with no bottom. The base is 12 ft on each side, and each triangle has a slant height of 10 ft. How many square feet of shingles cover the 4 triangles?
items.e: One triangle: 12 × 12 × 10 = 60 ft². Four triangles: 4 × 60 = 240 ft². The base is not part of the roof.

items.q: Ava paints the outside of a toy box with no lid. The box is 4 ft long, 2 ft wide and 2 ft tall. How many square feet does she paint?
items.e: All 6 faces: 2 × 8 + 2 × 8 + 2 × 4 = 40 ft². There is no top, so subtract one 4 × 2 face: 40 − 8 = 32 ft².

items.q: A cube has a surface area of 150 square centimeters. How long is each edge?
items.e: 6 faces share 150 square centimeters, so one face is 150 ÷ 6 = 25 square centimeters. A square with area 25 has 5 cm sides (5 × 5 = 25).

items.q: Mateo wraps 2 boxes that are the same. Each box is 6 cm by 4 cm by 3 cm. How much paper does he need for both boxes?
items.e: One box: 2 × 24 + 2 × 18 + 2 × 12 = 108 square centimeters. Two boxes: 2 × 108 = 216 square centimeters.

items.q: A wooden sandbox has a bottom but no top. It is 6 ft long, 4 ft wide and 1 ft tall. How many square feet of wood is it made of?
items.e: Bottom: 6 × 4 = 24. Long sides: 2 × (6 × 1) = 12. Short sides: 2 × (4 × 1) = 8. No top: 24 + 12 + 8 = 44 ft².

items.q: A room is 12 ft long, 10 ft wide and 8 ft tall. How many square feet are painted if the 4 walls and the ceiling are painted, but not the floor?
Camila wraps a gift box that is 12 in long, 8 in wide and 4 in tall. How much wrapping paper covers the box with no overlap?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (12 × 8) = 192. Front and back: 2 × (12 × 4) = 96. Two sides: 2 × (8 × 4) = 64. Add: 192 + 96 + 64 = 352 in².

items.q: Josiah covers only the 4 sides of a box (not the top or bottom). The box is 10 cm long, 6 cm wide and 8 cm tall. How much paper does he use?
items.e: Front and back: 2 × (10 × 8) = 160. Two sides: 2 × (6 × 8) = 96. Total: 160 + 96 = 256 square centimeters.

items.q: A cereal box is 8 in wide, 3 in deep and 12 in tall. How much cardboard is used to make it (no overlaps)?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (8 × 3) = 48. Front and back: 2 × (8 × 12) = 192. Two sides: 2 × (3 × 12) = 72. Add: 48 + 192 + 72 = 312 in².

items.q: A planter is a cube with an open top. Each edge is 2 ft. How much area of the outside is painted (no top)?
items.e: One face: 2 × 2 = 4 ft². The planter has 5 faces (no top): 5 × 4 = 20 ft².

items.q: Sofia paints all 6 faces of a wooden chest that is 5 ft long, 3 ft wide and 2 ft tall. Paint costs $2 for each square foot. How much does the paint cost?
Ximena paints every face of a wooden cube with 3 in edges. How much area does she paint?
items.e: One face: 3 × 3 = 9 in². Six faces: 6 × 9 = 54 in². 27 is the volume, and 36 counts only 4 faces.

items.q: A tent is a triangular prism. Each end is a triangle with a base of 6 ft and a height of 4 ft, and the slanted sides are 5 ft wide. The tent is 8 ft long. How much fabric covers the 2 ends, the 2 slanted sides and the floor?
items.e: Ends: 2 × 12 × 6 × 4 = 24. Slanted sides: 2 × 5 × 8 = 80. Floor: 6 × 8 = 48. Total: 24 + 80 + 48 = 152 ft².

items.q: Which unit could be used for the surface area of a box?
items.e: Surface area is the area of all the faces, so it is in square units, like in². Cubic inches measure volume.

items.q: A fish tank with no lid is 20 in long, 10 in wide and 12 in tall. How much glass is used to make it?
items.e: Bottom: 20 × 10 = 200. Front and back: 2 × (20 × 12) = 480. Ends: 2 × (10 × 12) = 240. No lid, so the total is 200 + 480 + 240 = 920 in².

items.q: A wooden ramp is a triangular prism. Its ends are right triangles with sides 5 ft, 12 ft and 13 ft, and the ramp is 3 ft wide. How much area is painted if every face is painted?
items.e: Ends: 2 × 12 × 5 × 12 = 60. Rectangles: (5 + 12 + 13) × 3 = 90. Total: 60 + 90 = 150 ft².

items.q: A tent has no floor. Its ends are triangles with a base of 8 ft and a height of 3 ft. The two slanted sides are 5 ft by 10 ft. How much fabric is in the tent?
items.e: Ends: 2 × 12 × 8 × 3 = 24. Sides: 2 × 5 × 10 = 100. No floor, so the total is 24 + 100 = 124 ft².

items.q: A paperweight is a square pyramid. Its base is 4 cm on each side, and each triangle face has a height of 5 cm. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Base: 4 × 4 = 16. Triangles: 4 × 12 × 4 × 5 = 40. Total: 16 + 40 = 56 square centimeters.
